compatibility.versionRequirement: Requires a release exposing the documented ACP entry; upstream does not specify a minimum version.
compatibility.runtime: Standalone binary; npm launcher depends on its installation.
caveats: Cross-process restore requires negotiated loadSession.

compatibility.versionRequirement: Requires a release exposing the documented ACP entry; upstream does not specify a minimum version.
compatibility.runtime: Node.js (npm installation); use the runtime required by the installed CLI.
compatibility.authentication: Gemini CLI login or configured API/Vertex provider.
caveats: Use --acp; --experimental-acp is deprecated.
Google AI Pro/Ultra and free Code Assist individuals stopped serving Gemini CLI on 2026-06-18; supported enterprise or paid API providers remain available.

compatibility.versionRequirement: Installed Claude Code compatible with Claude Agent SDK 0.3.274.
compatibility.runtime: Agent Remote Control-managed private Bun runtime and pinned ACP adapter, downloaded on first enable; no global Node/npm required.
compatibility.authentication: Adapter / Claude Agent SDK login and supported provider environment; Agent Remote Control stores no credentials.
caveats: Agent Remote Control provisions the ACP adapter on explicit enable and reuses the discovered Claude Code executable via CLAUDE_CODE_EXECUTABLE.
Discovery never downloads components. Agent installed/version describe Claude Code; available additionally requires prepared adapter components.
Authentication and provider configuration remain owned by Claude Code.
Client terminal/fs and opt-in extensions are not advertised by Agent Remote Control.

compatibility.versionRequirement: Requires a release exposing the documented ACP entry; upstream does not specify a minimum version.
compatibility.runtime: Official standalone CLI installation; no Agent Remote Control-managed Node/bun/npx.
compatibility.authentication: Existing Cursor CLI login or CURSOR_API_KEY / CURSOR_AUTH_TOKEN.
caveats: Generic agent executable must identify itself as Cursor and expose acp.
cursor/ask_question and cursor/create_plan extensions are unsupported (method-not-found); standard permissions are supported.
Team dashboard MCP servers are not supported by Cursor ACP.

compatibility.runtime: Official native Grok Build binary; no extra runtime.
compatibility.authentication: Grok login or XAI_API_KEY and Grok provider settings.
caveats: Use the official xAI Grok Build, not unrelated community grok packages.
Model/mode and session restoration depend on the installed server negotiation.

compatibility.versionRequirement: Requires a release exposing the documented ACP entry; upstream does not specify a minimum version.
compatibility.runtime: Node.js for npm cline; follow installed package engines.

compatibility.versionRequirement: Requires a release exposing the documented ACP entry; startup is checked against the installed executable.
compatibility.runtime: Official CodeBuddy CLI installation and its required runtime.
compatibility.authentication: Existing agent login and provider configuration; ARC does not configure credentials.

compatibility.versionRequirement: Requires a release exposing the documented ACP entry; startup is checked against the installed executable.
compatibility.runtime: Oh My Pi installation and its required runtime.
compatibility.authentication: Existing agent login and provider configuration; ARC does not configure credentials.

compatibility.versionRequirement: Requires the official ACP profile; startup is checked against the installed executable.
compatibility.runtime: DeepSeek Harness CLI or the CLI bundled with DeepSeek Harness Desktop.
compatibility.authentication: Existing DeepSeek Harness login and ACP profile configuration; ARC does not configure credentials.
caveats: Runs an ARC-owned ACP process using the acp profile; it does not control the Desktop window or import its active conversations.
Desktop-specific provider overrides are not copied to the ACP profile. Configure the native ACP profile if it uses a different model route.
Continuing after process shutdown requires negotiated session/load support; releases advertising only session/resume cannot resume through ARC.
